title: ContributionsPointsEvents
description: Domain events published by Contributions & Scoring (Unit 7), carried in the platform event envelope 'data' field, post-commit best-effort. Consumed by Notifications (US-8.15 rows: contribution decision, points adjusted) and Analytics. NOTE: there is NO TierAchieved event — tier-achievement notifications were removed (DL19); tiers are runtime-derived and displayed, never notified.

PointsAwarded.description: Points appended to the ledger for a member (auto award or evidence approval). `entries` carries the per-group portions (a community-wide award splits into several).

PointsAdjusted.description: A leader manually adjusted or reversed points (US-6.15). The affected member is notified in-portal (US-8.15 row). `reverses` set when this reversed a specific entry.

ContributionRejected.description: An evidence submission was rejected — by a leader (with reason) or by the system when the member left/was removed from the selected group before approval (`system: true`, US-6.6). Notification trigger only.
